# Captured 2026-09-24 on a FreeIPA/SSSD client (vm-target phr-gw, Ubuntu 24.04)
# right after phruser3 was added to FreeIPA: the cached group entry does not
# list phruser3 yet, while the user's own group list (id -Gn) does.
# Format per case: '=== <command>', 'rc=<n>', 'stdout=<...>', 'stderr=<...>'.
=== getent group role-pilot-portal-user
rc=0
stdout=role-pilot-portal-user:*:92400004:phruser,phruser2
stderr=
=== id -Gn -- phruser3
rc=0
stdout=phruser3 role-pilot-portal-user
stderr=
=== id -Gn -- phruser
rc=0
stdout=phruser role-pilot-portal-user role-pilot-session-auditor
stderr=
=== id -Gn -- no-such-user-xyz
rc=1
stdout=
stderr=id: ‘no-such-user-xyz’: no such user
=== getent group no-such-group-xyz
rc=2
stdout=
stderr=
